title.narrative: Support to agropastoral women for the management of risks related to environmental degradation through adaptation measures in areas at risk of inter-community conflict

description.narrative: As a joint programme of UNIDO and UNCDF, the main objective of this project is to consolidate the reconciliation and peacebuilding process in Central Mali. In this regard the project will provide the following main outputs: Output 1.1: Local planning and decision making is more inclusive, transparent, gender sensitive, climate change and natural resource management related conflict (UNCDF) Output 1.2: Capacity of communities, territorial communities and other local actors to integrate conflict / peace dimensions related to natural resource exploitation, gender and climate change adaptation into their local planning and budgeting systems work are reinforced (UNCDF) Output 1.3: green cash for work and investments (adaptation to climate change / conflict reduction) are carried out through local authorities via the LoCAL mechanism (UNCDF) Output 2.1: The technical and operational capacities of women's groups operating in the agropastoral sector are strengthened for green and sustainable IGAs (UNIDO) Output 2.2: The IDEA Funding Mechanism is implemented to finance green IGAs (UNIDO) The project will be funded by the PBF (United Nations Peacebuilding Fund) and intervenes is the framework of Gender Promotion Initiative within 18 months as designed by the PBF.
